cases.title: A time constraint, then a richer evaluation
cases.caption: The requested deadline is grounded and confirmed. Plan-bound feedback then updates the evaluated plan set.
cases.initial_input: Keep the overtaking goal. Complete this maneuver within 30 seconds from the task start.
cases.initial_original: 当前选定的超车目标继续保持，这回超车完成时刻从任务开始计最多30秒。
cases.llm_summary: Goal preserved. Current-task completion limit: 30 s. Explicit confirmation required.

events.title: Structured intent
events.detail: Logged local 9B output, followed by explicit condition confirmation.

events.title: Evaluate displayed alternatives
events.text: A and B both finish at 29 s, with different smoothness.

events.title: Plan-bound feedback
events.text: Both plans are acceptable. Completion time matters most.
events.detail: Recorded scenario text; the 9B parser resolves the current plan scope.

events.title: Preference evidence updated
events.detail: One joint update; the two endpoints are not counted as separate requests.

events.title: Updated plan selected
events.text: A 26 s completion plan with a 4.5 s lane transition.
events.detail: The planner evaluates the updated candidate set before automated execution.

events.title: Maneuver complete
events.text: The recorded vehicle returns to its target lane.
events.detail: Original simulation clock and request count are preserved.

cases.title: A comparison changes which plan can be selected
cases.caption: An acceptance evaluation and a later comparison supply different evidence. The selected recorded branch executes the 29 s alternative.
cases.initial_input: Keep the overtaking goal. Prioritize smoothness and keep the energy use under control.
cases.initial_original: 这回仍保持超车的按键目标，请尽可能平顺并控制耗电。
cases.llm_summary: Goal preserved. Current-task smoothness and energy preferences identified.

events.title: Driver goal and language
events.text: Keep overtaking; prioritize smoothness and energy.
events.detail: English translation of the recorded Chinese instruction.

events.title: Structured preferences
events.text: Smoothness and energy are relevant to this task.
events.detail: Logged local 9B output grounds the initial instruction.

events.title: First evaluation
events.text: Would you accept the 26 s plan A?
events.detail: A concrete displayed plan is evaluated.

events.title: Acceptance received
events.detail: An acceptance button updates the joint belief.

events.title: Compare A and B
events.text: A: finish at 26 s. B: finish at 29 s.
events.detail: This recorded branch uses a controlled comparison probe.

events.title: Relative preference received
events.text: B is preferred. The relative evaluation changes.
events.detail: Button feedback; this comparison did not make another LLM call.

events.title: Updated plan selected
events.text: The planner selects the 29 s plan B.
events.detail: The original acceptance and relative-gain checks remain active.

events.title: Maneuver complete
events.text: The recorded overtake completes and returns to its target lane.
events.detail: Selected episode replay, not an aggregate performance result.
